items.title: Switching entity advice
items.summary: Has anyone got experience in switching business entity on shopify. For eg switching from UK LTD to US LLC or sole trader to LTD? I’m looking to understand how long it takes the new Shopify payments to be verified and what the holds on the new accounts are like. I’m trying to do this with minimum disruption as the original Shopify payments will need to get deactivated whilst the new one is being verified. I’ve heard it can take minutes or hours. I’ve also heard it can take days.   submitted b
